crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…
Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly…
and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
“ ‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of…
Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse…
She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
“You shall say to this people, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.

translations.web: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
translations.bsb: For this commandment is a lamp, this teaching is a light, and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life,
translations.kjv: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
translations.asv: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; And reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
